item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNHCR stated that Bangladesh had consistently reaffirmed voluntary and sustainable Rohingya repatriation, while a Bangladesh–Myanmar pilot project considered possible returns; UNHCR said conditions in Myanmar were not conducive to sustainable return, no refugee should be forced to return, and consultation and informed choice were essential. UNHCR supported verification efforts involving a Myanmar delegation crossing into Bangladesh and noted the launch of the 2023 Joint Response Plan, which was 10% funded at the time.","notes":["The excerpt supports UNHCR logistical support for the verification process, but does not establish Bangladesh's participation in those efforts."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Office of the Comptroller and Auditor General of Bangladesh listed audit instructions, including an Audit Instructions entry designated 01/2023 (Financial Audit Reporting Format).","notes":["The excerpt provided does not show the claimed dates of 13 February, 5 July, 16 July, or 11 December 2023.","The excerpt does not state that the office audits government receipts and public spending or assesses value for money."]}]}
